title: 2001 AMC 10 Problem 17
statement: Which of the cones below can be formed from a \(252^\circ\) sector of a circle of radius \(10\) by aligning the two straight sides?

solutions.text:
When rolled into a cone, the sector’s radius \(10\) becomes the slant height, and the arc length becomes the base circumference.

The arc length is \(\dfrac{252}{360}\cdot2\pi\cdot10=14\pi,\) so \(2\pi r=14\pi\) gives base radius \(r=7.\) The cone has slant height \(10\) and base radius \(7.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The sector’s radius becomes the slant height of the cone
The arc length \(\dfrac{252}{360}\cdot2\pi\cdot10\) becomes the base circumference \(2\pi r\)
